title: A mail arrives
summary: A booking confirmation lands in iCloud Mail. The attention pass judges it work for Home & admin, and a short-lived work thread puts the stay on your calendar, notices check-in closes before you land, drafts a note in your voice into Drafts and posts one line into the space. Nothing is sent.

subject: Booking confirmed: 12–15 November
text: Dear Divy, your stay at Hotel Orto is confirmed for 12–15 November. Reception is open until 22:00.
